timing: Payments processed via Hyperwallet (bank account or PayPal withdrawal) on a per-project schedule — weekly, biweekly, or monthly depending on project and country.
who_pays: TELUS International pays you per completed task, sent through its payment partner Hyperwallet.
who_qualifies: 18+, anywhere in the world (the AI Community spans 1M+ contributors and 500+ languages). You must be authorized to work in your country of residence, pass the project's qualification exam, and verify your ID.
work_available: Limited and unpredictable: projects carry weekly hour caps (often 20–30 hours) and task supply is unpredictable. Getting hired takes 2–4 weeks of study, exams, and onboarding before your first paid task.
what_gets_accepted: Pay is per completed task that meets the project's quality thresholds — the hourly figures on postings are estimates, not a guaranteed wage. Failing the qualification exam means no access to that project.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: studying guidelines, taking qualification exams, and ID verification — 2–4 weeks of onboarding before you earn anything. PayPal/currency fees can apply outside the US.
when_cash_arrives: Via Hyperwallet (bank account or PayPal) on the project's own schedule — weekly, biweekly, or monthly depending on the project and country.

repeatable.cadence: New AI-training tasks post regularly — complete tasks, get paid via Hyperwallet, and pick up the next batch.
